milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the mossy cobblestone stairs (centered at spawn-relative [10, 0, 6]) and face them to demonstrate they have found them. The stairs form a 3-wide approach at the entrance of the ruin. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the stairs.

Uses inventory_has because mining mossy_stone_bricks with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with an iron pickaxe and the structure walls are made entirely of mossy_stone_bricks, so successfully mining at least one block will place mossy_stone_bricks in inventory. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.
